domain_context: Sports prediction app for MMGH community. Futuristic, high-stakes aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous spacing. p-4 to p-6 inside match cards to avoid text collision.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Control Room Grid for predictions. Tight gaps (gap-4). Matches span 1 column on mobile, 2 or 3 on desktop.
spacing_and_layout.responsive: Mobile-first stack. Elements must easily fit narrow screens (iPhone SE etc).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment for team flags and input scores to ensure exact center symmetry on match cards.

components.match_cards: Glassmorphism (Crystal variant). 1px inner border (border-white/10). On hover, subtle lift with cyan border glow. Include space for Home Flag, Home Score, Away Score, Away Flag, Kickoff, Venue, Group/Round, and Live Countdown badge.
components.inputs_score: Square or rounded-md. Inset background (bg-black/50), border-white/10. Focus: ring-2 ring-[#00F0FF]. Text centered, large, bold.
components.filters_chips: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Unselected: bg-white/5 border-white/10. Selected: bg-[#00F0FF] text-black font-bold shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)].
components.buttons_primary: Solid cyan or pink background, high contrast dark text, glow on hover. No generic pill shapes without sharp styling.
components.auto_lock_indicator: When match is locked (kickoff passed), reduce card opacity to 50%, change inputs to disabled/read-only, show red padlock icon.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Shift border colors or add subtle cyan/pink glow.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-colors duration-200), not transition-all.
interactions_and_motion.live_indicators: Pulsing animation (animate-pulse) on the live/countdown badges.

testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='predict-match-button').

image_urls.description: Aerial view of a night football match. Use with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70) for the landing screen background.
Shiny golden star trophies reflecting on a glass surface. Use for the Prize Info section (1st $250, 2nd $100, 3rd $50).
Black and white ball illustration. Can be used as a subtle background watermark for empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using .js files only (React/Next.js as applicable). Do NOT use TypeScript.
Ensure the contest is branded 'MMGH FIFA World Cup 2026 Prediction Contest'.
Sponsorship by 'FrameX LGS' must be clearly displayed in the prize section.
The admin panel should be password protected and show full leaderboards.
Regular users should ONLY see a public stats page (participant count) and NOT the leaderboard, to keep rankings anonymous.
Implement the scoring system: +1 correct winner, +3 exact score, +4 perfect (winner+score).
For 48 country flags, try to use a reliable flag icon library (like flag-icons) or high-quality emoji strings for performance.
Make sure locked matches (past kickoff) are read-only and distinctly styled.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on every interactable element.
